turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit properly, books closed. Today we are doing subtraction. First sum, fifty two minus twenty seven.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote thirty five? No, no. That is wrong. Next.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Listen. The answer is twenty five. 52 minus 27 is 25. Everybody write twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjoon, you also wrote thirty five? I just told, it is twenty five. When the ones are small you borrow. Borrow and then subtract. BORROW and then SUBTRACT.
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Thumbs up if you got twenty five. Okay, quickly, thumbs up.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Next sum. Forty three minus eighteen. Do it fast.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, why are you counting on fingers? Stop that, you are in class two now. Put hands down.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Answer is twenty five again. 43 minus 18 is 25. Correct it in your book.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: One more. Sixty one minus twenty nine. Everybody try, no talking.
turns.label: new_sum
